definitions.explanation: A time far in the past. Used to refer to events, periods, or memories from a long time ago.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠|とお}い{昔|むかし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
examples.english: That's a story from long ago.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}い{昔|むかし}、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧だったそうだ。
examples.english: I hear that long ago, this area was the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{遠|とお}い{昔|むかし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことで、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えていない→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: Things from my childhood feel like the distant past — I can barely remember them anymore.

notes:
A phrase combining ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧ (distant/far) and ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧ (the past/old times). Functions as a set expression to emphasize how far back in time something was. Often used to begin stories or reminiscences, similar to English "long, long ago."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠|とお}い{昔|むかし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ — a story from long ago
- {遠|とお}い{昔|むかし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと — something from the distant past
- {遠|とお}い{昔|むかし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — long ago (adverbial use)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大昔|おおむかし}→大昔：12186_oomukashi⟧ — a very long time ago (single compound word; can feel even more distant)
- ⟦{昔々|むかしむかし}→昔々：27088_mukashimukashi⟧ — once upon a time (fairy-tale opening; more formulaic)
- ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ — a long time ago (more casual, everyday expression)
- {古|いにしえ} — antiquity; ancient times (literary/poetic register)
